# Problem statement

**The problem.** Team members cannot share availability with external guests without exposing event details.

**The users.** Members who organise meetings with people outside the organisation, and those outside guests.

**What exists.** Calendars are private to the organisation. Invitations reach external addresses by email.

## Constraints
- No guest accounts.
- Revocable at any time.

## Success criteria
- A guest sees free and busy times within one click of the link.

## User stories
- `user-story-share-with-guest` (drafted): as a member, I share my calendar with one outside guest, and I can take it back at any time.
- `user-story-see-availability` (drafted): as a guest, I open the link and see when the member is free, and I can propose a time when the member allows it.

## Out of scope
- Accounts for guests.
- Editing a member's events from outside the organisation.
